title: COMP 3522 C++ · Midterm
subtitle: Thursday Oct 29, 3:30 pm, SW03-1710, 90 minutes, one double-sided cheat sheet: Weeks 1 to 7
description: Starts with the Midterm Review chapter: seven lessons for five hours from zero, and a printed Arial-10 cheat sheet. The practice midterm, worked: sixteen theory questions with model answers written the way the marker expects, the three read-the-code questions traced line by line with the real output, the six Fraction questions built into one program you can run, and a mock midterm in the real format (multiple choice and true/false, definitions, write the output, a short and a guided long coding question). Ends with the cheat sheet you copy by hand, both sides, Weeks 1 to 7.
intro:
:::quiz Midterm facts
**Thursday Oct 29, 3:30 pm, room SW03-1710, 90 minutes, on paper.** Arrive 10 minutes early. Covers everything up to and including Week 7. One page, double-sided cheat sheet, handwritten or printed in Arial 10 pt or larger (the practice paper's "no cheat sheets" line is the old rule). Format: multiple choice and true/false; definitions; read a code snippet and write the output; a short coding question; a long coding question broken into guided parts. Instructor's strategy: slides and their links, the sample code referenced in the slides, labs and assignments, the coding challenges in the lectures, this practice midterm, your old quiz attempts (Activities > Quizzes > Quiz 2 > Submissions > Attempt 1), and "topic geeks for geeks" searches. Next week is review; anonymous topic requests at https://forms.gle/HAcpDu8cZTw5yY9bA.
:::

plan.title: Five hours from zero, then the exam

steps.note: 10 minutes: print the sheet double-sided (Letter, Arial 10) and read where everything is
60 minutes: the trace rules, Q20, Q27, Q28, the ParentChild variants; predict every program before you run it
40 minutes: the box pictures, swap three ways, new/delete, the five definitions written in three moves
40 minutes: copy constructor, const, destructor timing, initialization, ::, struct, forward declaration
60 minutes: write every part on paper first, then in the challenge; the file-to-stack main last
35 minutes: abstract, interface, diamond, copy-and-swap, each from its code
35 minutes: the four quizzes; reread the rule behind every miss
if time remains: the mock, on paper, with the printed sheet

chapters.title: Midterm Review: five hours from zero

lessons.title: Review 1: tracing constructors, destructors and copies (Q20, Q27, Q28 and the review programs: about 15 marks plus MC)
Review 2: pointers, references and memory (Q2 to Q6: 19 marks of definitions)
Review 3: the class questions written in three moves (Q1, Q7 to Q12: 24 marks)
Review 4: write Fraction from a blank page (Q21 to Q26: 24 marks of code)
Review 5: abstract classes, interfaces, the diamond and copy-and-swap (Q13 to Q16: 14 marks)
Review 6: the multiple-choice and true-or-false bank for Weeks 1, 5, 6 and 7
Review 7: the printed cheat sheet: what is on each side and when to open it
